name: office-agent-skills
description: Agent Skills for building PowerPoint decks and Word reports in code (pptxgenjs, docx), usable by Antigravity, Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Codex and other agents.

scripts.test: node skills/pptx-deck-builder/templates/example_deck.js out/example_deck.pptx && node skills/pptx-deck-builder/scripts/render.js out/example_deck.pptx out/deck_render && node skills/docx-report-builder/templates/example_report.js out/example_report.docx && node skills/docx-report-builder/scripts/render.js out/example_report.docx out/report_render
scripts.sync: node -e "const fs=require('fs');for(const f of ['_deps.js','render.js','extract_docx.js'])fs.copyFileSync('skills/pptx-deck-builder/scripts/'+f,'skills/docx-report-builder/scripts/'+f);console.log('synced shared scripts')"
